steps.code:
# Create notes for all remaining files
sn_token = sn_login['access_token']
created_notes = []

for file_path in fs_dir:
    # Derive title from filename
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    title = filename[:-3].replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Read file content
    file_details = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
    content = file_details['content']
    
    # Create note in simple_note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    created_notes.append((title, result))
    print(f"Created note: '{title}' -> {result}")

print(f"\nTotal notes created: {len(created_notes)}")
